CommunityApplications.Profile: OctoFarm-Redux is a maintained fork of OctoFarm, the web interface that unifies multiple OctoPrint instances into one dashboard. Upstream development stopped at the end of 2022; this fork brings it back to current dependencies and fixes the faults that had accumulated, without changing how the application works day to day. The Unraid image here is self-contained - MongoDB runs inside the same container, so there is nothing to deploy alongside it.
CommunityApplications.DonateText: OctoFarm-Redux is free. If it is useful to you, you can leave a tip.
